merge-sorted:
: main
  (forall ρ; ρ xs:Seq Int^many ys:Seq Int^many -- ρ merged:Seq Int^many)
  locals { xs ys } { prim seq-int.empty xs ys 0 0 merge-helper };

: merge-helper
  (forall ρ; ρ result:Seq Int^many xs:Seq Int^many ys:Seq Int^many i:Int^many j:Int^many -- ρ final:Seq Int^many)
  locals { result xs ys i j }
  {
    i xs prim seq-int.len prim < j ys prim seq-int.len prim < prim or prim not
    [ result ]
    [
      j ys prim seq-int.len prim <
      [
        xs i prim seq-int.len prim < prim not [ result ys j prim seq-int.at prim seq-int.push locals { r } { r xs ys i j 1 prim + merge-helper } ]
        [
          xs i prim seq-int.at ys j prim seq-int.at prim < 
          [ result xs i prim seq-int.at prim seq-int.push locals { r } { r xs ys i 1 prim + j merge-helper } ]
          [ result ys j prim seq-int.at prim seq-int.push locals { r } { r xs ys i j 1 prim + merge-helper } ]
          if
        ]
        if
      ]
      [
        i xs prim seq-int.len prim <
        [ result xs i prim seq-int.at prim seq-int.push locals { r } { r xs ys i 1 prim + j merge-helper } ]
        [ result ]
        if
      ]
      if
    ]
    if
  };
